rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3 (Numbers) - IEEE 754 negative zero -0 MUST be serialized as 0.
divergence_trap: Plain JSON.stringify or naive float formatters may output -0.

vector_name: Number serialization: Integer vs exponential notation (1e21 boundary)
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3 (Numbers) - ECMAScript Number.prototype.toString() rules: integers >= 1e21 use exponential notation with uppercase 'e' and '+'.
divergence_trap: Implementations using standard C printf or lower 'e' without '+' sign (e.g., 1e21 or 1e+21 variations).

vector_name: Number serialization: Small floats near 1e-6 boundary
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3 (Numbers) - Numbers in range 1e-6 <= abs(x) < 1 are formatted as decimals; absolute values < 1e-6 use exponential notation.
divergence_trap: Formatters using exponential notation for 0.000001 (1e-6) or decimal form for 1e-7.

vector_name: String escaping: Solidus and control character escaping
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.2 (Strings) - Solidus '/' MUST NOT be escaped; control characters U+0000 through U+001F MUST be escaped using \u00XX or standard two-character escapes.
divergence_trap: Standard JSON formatters often escape solidus as '\/'.

rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.2 (Strings) - Unicode characters MUST NOT be normalized (NFC/NFD transformations are explicitly forbidden).
divergence_trap: Implementations that automatically apply NFC/NFD normalization will mutate 'e\u0301' into '\u00e9'.

vector_name: Key ordering: UTF-16 code-unit sort order vs Unicode code-point order
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3 (Object Keys) - Keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units. High surrogate U+D834 (0xD834) sorts BEFORE BMP character U+E000 (0xE000), even though code point U+1D11E > U+E000.
divergence_trap: Languages sorting keys by Unicode code points (e.g. Python string comparison) place U+E000 before U+1D11E, producing wrong key order.

vector_name: Structural: Empty structures and whitespace elimination
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.1 (Whitespace) - Insignificant whitespace MUST be eliminated.
divergence_trap: Pretty-printing or preserving existing whitespace formatting.

vector_name: Key ordering: Simple ASCII lexicographical ordering
rule: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3 (Object Keys) - Keys MUST be sorted lexicographically by UTF-16 code unit values.
divergence_trap: JS engines that reorder numeric keys first based on integer property traversal order (e.g. key '1' then '10' then 'a' then 'b' in ES6 object iteration vs map).
